simulator:
msopprof (MindStudio Profiler For Operator) is part of MindStudio Operator-dev Tools.
Used for Ascend C operator profiling by running on the simulator.

Options:
   --help / -h                        <Optional> Help message.
   --config                           <Optional> Json file for op config path
   --application                      <Optional> Executable file path
   --export                           <Optional> Specify the dump data path for parsing
   --output                           <Optional> Output path
   --kernel-name                      <Optional> Specify the kernel name to profile. It's not effective in config mode.
   --aic-metrics=metric1,metric2,...  <Optional> Enable PipeUtilization / ResourceConflictRatio / PMSampling metrics. PipeUtilization is required
   --launch-count                     <Optional> Number of kernel that can be collected, number in [1, 5000].
   --mstx                             <Optional> Enable mstx api or not, select on / off, the default value is off.
   --mstx-include                     <Optional> Specify the mstx range for msprof op to be collected.
   --soc-version                      <Optional> Specify a simulator in ascend toolkit. It's not effective in config mode.
   --core-id                          <Optional> Specify the id of cores to be parsed.
   --timeout                          <Optional> Set the timeout minutes for application runs, range in [1, 2880].
   --dump                             <Optional> Enable or disable dump flushed to disk mode, This parameter is valid only for A2/A3.
